blocks.text: JewelryWe Womens Wrist Watch Gold Tone Metal Watchband Wrist Watch Analog Arabic Dial Quartz Watch Business Casual Dress Watch

Highlights:
 Modern quartz movement makes the watch a precise time keeper.
 Distinct hands with Arabic numerals for a easy reader dial.
 The strap is comfortable to wear.
 Elastic strap for easy take on and off, very convenient, and fit all size wrists.
 This fashion watch offers women of all ages with a unique casual look.
 It looks great and more importantly keeps accurate time.
 Dress up your work attire and be on time for your meetings.
 Every watch comes with a blue velvet gift bag printed “JewelryWe” on it.

Material:
 Movement: Quartz
 Case Material: Metal
 Band Material: Alloy

Specification:
 Dial Case Diameter: 1.06"(2.7cm)
 Dial Case Thickness: 0.31"(0.8cm)
 Band width: 0.55"(1.4cm)
 Band Length: 7.68"(19.5cm) (includes the case)
 Watch Weight: 18g

What Is in the Package:
 Wrist Watch x 1
 Gift Bag x 1

items.label: PRECISE AND EASY-TO-READ
items.value: Engineered for instant time checks, this simple watch equipped with quartz movement features an clear dial with bold, high-contrast Arabic numerals. The large numbers ensure clarity at a glance.

items.label: ALL-DAY COMFORT WITH PERFECT FIT
items.value: This fashion watch features an elastic strap suitable for wrist sizes ranging from 16.5cm to 28cm (6.5in to 11.02in), ensuring comfort during extended wear. It’s designed for all-day wear without irritation, making it ideal for work, travel, and daily activities.

items.label: DURABLE MATERIAL FOR DAILY WEAR
items.value: Built with a hypoallergenic polished metal case and band, and constructed with a glass window and stainless steel back, the women stretchy band watch is resistant to scratches, ensuring durability and a long-lasting appearance.

items.label: PREMIUM VALUE & THOUGHTFUL GIFTING
items.value: Offering the look and feel of more expensive timepieces at an exceptional value, this women's ultra thin watch is a great gift for Birthday, Christmas, Valentine's Day, Anniversary, Mothers Day, Wedding, etc. Its classic, versatile design suits both casual and business-casual settings.

items.label: CARE INSTRUCTIONS
items.value: The solid dress watch is daily water resistant, safe for facing rain, sweat , and accidental splashes. DO NOT use when wash hands, bathing, swimming, or diving. The wristwatch arrives ready to wear with the battery installed and includes a spare battery for future convenience. Please remove the white buckle and push the crown inward to make the watch work.

items.label: Included Components
items.value: Watch, Blue Velvet Gift Bag, Extra Battery
